title: Hyperdimensional computing benchmark, Raspberry Pi vs GPU
highlights: Deployed an HDC model for MNIST classification on a Raspberry Pi 4 and Google Colab, with dimensionality 5000 vs 10000 for constrained and accelerated platforms.
Achieved 82.75% accuracy in 1741 s on the Pi (496 MB) versus 82.99% in 96.6 s on Colab (205 MB).
Used GPIO-triggered events, with PyTorch and TorchHD for implementation, evaluation and visualization of lightweight AI for edge computing.
